text: Note: a. We’ll start the visa application procedure for the students, after getting their application fees. b. Students should pay all the fees for their first year’s study within one week after their arrival. Nigerian students should wire all the fees for their first year’s study to my university before we send out the jw202 and admission notice. c. Students have to pay separately for the Internet connection in their room: 30RMB/month. d. Students have to pay separately for the electricity and water used in their room: depends on usage. e. Because of the limitation of quota of postgraduates, please remind the students to sign up as early as possible. f. Book fees are collected according to the true price.
